name: How is a split door frame repaired after a forced entry?

mainEntity.name: How is a split door frame repaired after a forced entry?

acceptedAnswer.text: Repairing a door frame after a break-in requires checking both the finish jamb and the structural studs behind it. If the wood is only split along the strike plate, a carpenter can remove the damaged section, splice in new solid lumber, install an extended heavy-duty strike plate, and anchor it with 3-inch screws directly into the wall stud. If the king or jack studs behind the casing are fractured, the casing and drywall must be opened to repair the rough framing before reinstalling a new jamb.
acceptedAnswer.description: A split frame is repaired by splicing in sound wood, reinforcing the latch area with long screws into the wall stud, or replacing the damaged jamb section if the structural stud is intact.
